slides.headline: 47,000 women and girls killed by partners or family
slides.subline: **That is about five every hour.** UN data for 2025, released Nov 24.

slides.body: In 2025 about [[47,000]] women and girls were killed by an intimate partner or family member. That is **129 a day**, roughly [[five every hour]].
They made up about **60%** of all women and girls killed intentionally worldwide in 2025. The figures cover **122 countries and territories**.
Africa [[22,100]] · Asia **15,100** · Americas **7,400** · Europe **2,100** · Oceania **300**. These are totals, so they also reflect population size.
Adjusted for population, Africa is highest at [[2.9]], then the Americas **1.4**, Oceania **1.1**, Asia **0.6** and Europe **0.5**.
The 2024 estimate was **50,000**. The UN says the lower 2025 figure is **not a real decline**; it largely reflects better data. Is enough being done to stop this?
